about: Opportunistic, often buying what others are selling.
summary: Concentrated: 25 holdings, but the top ten are 82% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 89% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 4.6 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced, more profitable, faster-growing and much larger.
Copying each filing beat the S&P 500 in 5 of 9 full years.

profile.background: Born in 1957 in Pittsburgh; University of Pittsburgh and Carnegie Mellon (the Tepper School of Business is named after him). Founded Appaloosa Management. Owns the Carolina Panthers.
profile.approach: Opportunistic: buys what others are selling in a panic, from distressed debt to out-of-favour shares, and changes positions often.
known: Earned $2.2 billion in the 2012 tax year, the most of any hedge fund manager that year (Institutional Investor's Alpha).
Has said he plans eventually to turn Appaloosa into a family office.

name: David Tepper
